study type: Semi-experimental (pretest and post test control group)
cohort: 60 postnatal mothers who had undergone cesarean delivery were selected using non-probability purposive sampling.
finding: Hand and Foot Massage was found to be effective in significantly reducing pain among post-cesarean mothers in the experimental group.
mod_finding: The study's primary finding is that Hand and Foot Massage was effective in reducing pain specifically among mothers who had undergone cesarean delivery.
